name: Q1.card_blockUnion
statement:
theorem card_blockUnion {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → G) (P : Finset α)
    (h : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (imageBlock (t i) P) (imageBlock (t j) P))) :

name: Q1.card_blockUnion_le
statement:
theorem card_blockUnion_le {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → G) (P : Finset α) :

name: Q1.card_imageBlock

name: Q1.greedy_disjoint_blocks

    (hdisp : ∀ F : Finset α, F.card ≤ (N - 1) * P.card →
      ∃ t : G, L.length t ≤ R ∧ Disjoint (imageBlock t P) F) :

name: Q1.imageBlock_disjoint

theorem imageBlock_disjoint (g : G) {P Q : Finset α} (h : Disjoint P Q) :

name: Q1.imageBlock_disjoint_iff
statement:
theorem imageBlock_disjoint_iff (g : G) (P Q : Finset α) :
    Disjoint (imageBlock g P) (imageBlock g Q) ↔ Disjoint P Q

name: Q1.imageBlock_inv
statement:

name: Q1.imageBlock_inv'

name: Q1.imageBlock_mono

theorem imageBlock_mono (g : G) {P Q : Finset α} (h : P ⊆ Q) :

name: Q1.imageBlock_mul
statement:
theorem imageBlock_mul (g h : G) (Q : Finset α) :

name: Q1.imageBlock_one
statement: @[simp] theorem imageBlock_one (Q : Finset α) : imageBlock (1 : G) Q = Q

name: Q1.mem_imageBlock

name: Q1.mem_orbitBall

name: Q1.orbitBall_card_le_imageBlocks

name: Q1.orbitBall_mono
statement:
theorem orbitBall_mono (L : LengthBall G) {r s : ℕ} (hrs : r ≤ s) (x : α) :

name: Q1.orbitBall_subset_imageBlocks_union
statement:
theorem orbitBall_subset_imageBlocks_union (L : LengthBall G) (r : ℕ)

name: Q1.orbitBall_transfer

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_add
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_add (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_mem
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_mem (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal A) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ I) :

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_one
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_one (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (hN : 0 < N) :

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_smul
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_smul (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)
    (c : ℂ) (a : A) :
    conjugationAverage u t (c • a) = c • conjugationAverage u t a

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_sub
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_sub (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)
    (a b : A) :
    conjugationAverage u t (a - b) =

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_sum
statement:
theorem conjugationAverage_sum (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)

name: Q1.conjugationAverage_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugationAverage_zero (u : G →* A) {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) :

name: Q1.hasConjugationAveraging_of_dense
statement:
theorem hasConjugationAveraging_of_dense [Nontrivial A]
    (u : G →* A) (τ : A →L[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hu : ∀ g : G, ‖u g‖ ≤ 1) (hτ : ∀ a : A, ‖τ a‖ ≤ ‖a‖)
    (D : Set A) (hD : Dense D)
    (haverage : ∀ a ∈ D, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →

statement:
theorem norm_conjugationAverage_le (u : G →* A) (hu : ∀ g : G, ‖u g‖ ≤ 1)

statement:
theorem blockMultiplicity_eq_one {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (imageBlock (t i) P) (imageBlock (t j) P)))
    {x : α} (hx : x ∈ blockUnion t P) : blockMultiplicity t P x = 1

name: Q1.blockMultiplicity_eq_pair_count
statement:
theorem blockMultiplicity_eq_pair_count {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G)
    (P : Finset α) (x : α) :
    blockMultiplicity t P x =
      ((Finset.univ.product P).filter (fun p : Fin N × α => t p.1 • p.2 = x)).card

name: Q1.blockMultiplicity_eq_zero
statement:
theorem blockMultiplicity_eq_zero {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)

statement:
theorem blockMultiplicity_le_one {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (imageBlock (t i) P) (imageBlock (t j) P)))

statement:
theorem translators_injective {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)

name: Q1.uniformBlockCoefficient_energy
statement:
theorem uniformBlockCoefficient_energy {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N)

theorem uniformBlockCoefficient_off_union {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)

name: Q1.uniformBlockCoefficient_on_union
statement:
theorem uniformBlockCoefficient_on_union {N : ℕ} (t : Fin N → G) (P : Finset α)

theorem conjugacyGrowthConstant_le_one (q : ℝ) (k M D : ℕ)

name: Q1.exponential_lower_bound_of_sampled_power
statement:
theorem exponential_lower_bound_of_sampled_power
    (β : ℕ → ℝ) (hβ : ∀ r, 1 ≤ β r) (hmono : Monotone β)
    (q : ℝ) (k M D : ℕ) (hq : 1 < q) (hk : 0 < k) (hM : 0 < M)
    (hsampled : ∀ n : ℕ, q ^ n ≤ β (M * n + D) ^ k) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, conjugacyGrowthConstant q k M D *
      Real.exp (conjugacyGrowthRate q k M * r) ≤ β r

name: Q1.exists_disjoint_of_sunflower
statement:
theorem exists_disjoint_of_sunflower
    (family : Finset (Finset α)) (core F : Finset α)
    (hflower : IsSunflower family core)
    (hsize : F.card < family.card) (hdisj : Disjoint core F) :
    ∃ A ∈ family, Disjoint A F

name: Q1.exists_sunflower
statement:
theorem exists_sunflower (k n : ℕ) (_hk : 1 ≤ k) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (family : Finset (Finset α))
    (hcard : ∀ A ∈ family, A.card = k)
    (hlarge : k.factorial * n ^ k < family.card) :
    ∃ subfamily core, subfamily ⊆ family ∧ subfamily.card = n + 1 ∧
      core.card < k ∧ IsSunflower subfamily core ∧
      (∀ A ∈ subfamily, core ⊆ A)

name: Q1.displacement_cost
statement:
theorem displacement_cost (k ℓ B A : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ < k) :
    (2 ^ ℓ - 1) * (2 * B + A + A) + (B + A) ≤
      (2 ^ k - 1) * (B + A)

name: Q1.finite_threshold_displacement
statement:
theorem finite_threshold_displacement (L : LengthBall G) (P F : Finset α)
    (m A : ℕ) (hF : 1 ≤ F.card)
    (hgrowth : ∀ x ∈ P, m * (m.factorial * F.card ^ m) < (orbitBall L A x).card)
    (Q : Finset α) (hQm : Q.card ≤ m) (B : ℕ)
    (hQ : RepresentedWithin L P Q B) :
    ∃ z : G, L.length z ≤ (2 ^ Q.card - 1) * (B + A) ∧
      Disjoint (imageBlock z Q) F

name: Q1.finite_threshold_packing
statement:
theorem finite_threshold_packing (L : LengthBall G) (P : Finset α) (N A : ℕ)
    (hgrowth : ∀ x ∈ P,
      P.card * (P.card.factorial * ((N - 1) * P.card) ^ P.card) <
        (orbitBall L A x).card) :
    ∃ t : Fin N → G, (∀ i, L.length (t i) ≤ (2 ^ P.card - 1) * A) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (imageBlock (t i) P) (imageBlock (t j) P))

name: Q1.representedWithin_image
statement:
theorem representedWithin_image (L : LengthBall G) (P Q : Finset α)
    (B r : ℕ) (u : G) (hu : L.length u ≤ r)
    (hQ : RepresentedWithin L P Q B) :

name: Q1.representedWithin_mono
statement:
theorem representedWithin_mono (L : LengthBall G) (P Q Q' : Finset α)

name: Q1.representedWithin_self

theorem representedWithin_self (L : LengthBall G) (P : Finset α) :

name: Q1.sunflower_threshold_mono

theorem sunflower_threshold_mono (k m n : ℕ) (hkm : k ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :

name: Q1.conjugateBlock_subset_ball
statement:
theorem conjugateBlock_subset_ball (L : LengthBall G) (t : G) (P : Finset G)
    (R ℓ : ℕ) (ht : L.length t ≤ R) (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, L.length x ≤ ℓ) :

name: Q1.conjugate_length_le
statement:
theorem conjugate_length_le (L : LengthBall G) (t x : G) :

name: Q1.conjugationLengthBall_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugationLengthBall_length (L : LengthBall G) (g : ConjAct G) :

name: Q1.conjugation_orbitBall
statement:
theorem conjugation_orbitBall (L : LengthBall G) (r : ℕ) (x : G) :

      (L.ball r).image (fun t => t * x * t⁻¹)

name: Q1.imageBlock_toConjAct

theorem imageBlock_toConjAct (g : G) (P : Finset G) :

name: Q1.exists_mem_wordBall
statement:
theorem exists_mem_wordBall (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g : G) :

name: Q1.exists_word_length_eq
statement:
theorem exists_word_length_eq (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)

statement:
theorem exists_word_of_generates (S : Finset G)

statement:
theorem mem_wordBall_iff (S : Finset G) (g : G) (n : ℕ) :
    g ∈ wordBall S n ↔
      ∃ w : List G, w.length ≤ n ∧ (∀ s ∈ w, s ∈ S) ∧ w.prod = g

name: Q1.wordLengthBall_length_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem wordLengthBall_length_eq_zero_iff (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g : G) :
    (wordLengthBall S hsym hgen).length g = 0 ↔ g = 1

name: Q1.wordLengthBall_length_le_iff
statement:
theorem wordLengthBall_length_le_iff (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g : G) (n : ℕ) :
    (wordLengthBall S hsym hgen).length g ≤ n ↔
      ∃ w : List G, w.length ≤ n ∧ (∀ s ∈ w, s ∈ S) ∧ w.prod = g

name: Q1.wordLength_inv
statement:
theorem wordLength_inv (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g : G) :
    wordLength S hsym hgen g⁻¹ = wordLength S hsym hgen g

name: Q1.wordLength_le_iff
statement:
theorem wordLength_le_iff (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g : G) (n : ℕ) :

      ∃ w : List G, w.length ≤ n ∧ (∀ s ∈ w, s ∈ S) ∧ w.prod = g

name: Q1.wordLength_mul
statement:
theorem wordLength_mul (S : Finset G)
    (hsym : ∀ s ∈ S, s⁻¹ ∈ S)
    (hgen : Subgroup.closure (S : Set G) = ⊤) (g h : G) :
    wordLength S hsym hgen (g * h) ≤

theorem wordLength_one (S : Finset G)

statement:

    0 < packingLogK P.card δ ∧ 0 ≤ packingLogB P.card c δ ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N →

          packingLogK P.card δ * Real.log (N : ℝ) + packingLogB P.card c δ ∧
        ∃ t : Fin N → G,

          Pairwise (fun i j =>
            Disjoint (imageBlock (t i) P) (imageBlock (t j) P))

    ∃ (R : ℕ → ℕ) (K B : ℝ), 0 < K ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
      (∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → (R N : ℝ) ≤ K * Real.log (N : ℝ) + B) ∧
      ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → ∃ t : Fin N → G,
        (∀ i, L.length (t i) ≤ R N) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (conjugateBlock (t i) P) (conjugateBlock (t j) P))

    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => t i * g * (t i)⁻¹)) :
    ‖conjugationAverage regularRepresentation t (leftRegular g)‖ ≤
      reducedRho L (2 * R + ℓ) * Real.sqrt (1 / (N : ℝ))

    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j =>
      Disjoint (conjugateBlock (t i) f.support) (conjugateBlock (t j) f.support))) :
    ‖conjugationAverage regularRepresentation t (regularConvolution f)‖ ≤
      (∑ g ∈ f.support, ‖f g‖) *
        (reducedRho L (2 * R + ℓ) * Real.sqrt (1 / (N : ℝ)))
